tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground on every inside page and on seasonal covers. Runs to the paper edge (prints as a white rim inside the printer's 1/4in dead zone).

tokens.name: paper-tint
tokens.usage: Fill behind a highlighted group on paper, e.g. the Hand-Breaded to Order box. Text on it uses ink, ink-soft and maroon as on paper.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Item names, section headings, section rules and footer rule on paper and paper-tint (15:1 on paper, 13:1 on paper-tint). Also the fill of dark feature callouts (Black Squirrel, We Cater).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Item descriptions and fine print on paper (9.6:1) and paper-tint (8.2:1).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Italic serving notes, footer text and address lines on paper (8.2:1).

tokens.name: maroon
tokens.usage: Brand red. Page titles, prices, the TKB Diner cover title, and the fill of the Prime Rib callout. Text on paper (8:1) and paper-tint (6.8:1).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Brand teal. Kickers (TKB DINER), small uppercase labels, cover tagline rules and outlined boxes (Sampler, Dressings). Text on paper (5.8:1); never body copy.

tokens.name: leader
tokens.usage: Dotted price leaders, chip outlines and dotted dividers on paper. Decorative only: never text.

tokens.name: table-rule
tokens.usage: Row rules inside tables (Beer). Decorative only.

tokens.name: check-red
tokens.usage: Red squares of the checkerboard band on paper. Only in the band.

tokens.name: on-dark
tokens.usage: Text and price leaders' ground colour on ink and maroon fills (15:1 on ink, 8:1 on maroon).

tokens.name: on-dark-soft
tokens.usage: Descriptions inside dark ink callouts (12.3:1 on ink).

tokens.name: on-dark-price
tokens.usage: Price inside the dark Black Squirrel callout (10.5:1 on ink).

tokens.name: on-maroon-label
tokens.usage: Small uppercase label and description inside the maroon Prime Rib callout (6.3:1 on maroon).

tokens.name: on-dark-label
tokens.usage: Small uppercase label (WE CATER) inside dark ink callouts (9.8:1 on ink).

tokens.name: cover-ground
tokens.usage: Charcoal ground of the regular cover only. Matches the logo artwork's own background.

tokens.name: copper
tokens.usage: Regular cover: the outer frame line and the rules beside the tagline. Decorative, 4.2:1 on cover-ground.

tokens.name: copper-dark
tokens.usage: Regular cover: the inner frame line. Decorative only.

tokens.name: copper-light
tokens.usage: Regular cover: the TKB Diner title on cover-ground (5.4:1).

tokens.name: cover-text
tokens.usage: Regular cover: tagline, address and Facebook line on cover-ground (10.4:1).

tokens.name: cover-text-strong
tokens.usage: Regular cover: the phone number on cover-ground (12.7:1).

styles.name: cover-title
styles.usage: The TKB Diner name on a cover, in maroon (copper-light on the charcoal regular cover, 92px there). 66pt.

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: One per inside page, in maroon, under the kicker. 40.5pt.

styles.name: feature-name
styles.usage: Item name inside a feature callout (22px for the Black Squirrel, 26px for Prime Rib).

styles.name: section-heading
styles.usage: Section heading in ink, followed by a 2px ink rule that fills the rest of the column.

styles.name: callout-heading
styles.sample: Hosting an event, a wedding or a business meeting?
styles.usage: Headline inside the We Cater style callout.

styles.name: item-name
styles.usage: Every menu item name, in ink, Title Case.

styles.name: price
styles.usage: Price at the end of the leader, in maroon. 15px in compact lists.

styles.name: table-cell
styles.usage: Beer table: row labels 600 in ink, prices 700 in maroon, right-aligned.

styles.name: address
styles.usage: Address and Join us on Facebook lines on a cover, in ink-muted.

styles.name: list-item
styles.usage: Compact lists (Sides & Extras, entree sides) in ink.

styles.name: tagline
styles.usage: Cover tagline, uppercase, in teal between two 56px teal rules.

styles.name: description
styles.sample: Ham, cheddar, potatoes, onions, peppers and two eggs
styles.usage: The line under an item name, in ink-soft, sentence case. 9.75pt: the smallest size for menu content.

styles.name: note
styles.sample: Served with your choice of toast
styles.usage: Serving notes under a section heading, italic, in ink-muted.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Add-on chips; the price inside is 700 in maroon.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase line above every page title, in teal.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase sub-group labels (DELI CLASSICS, ADD, DRESSINGS) in teal; in maroon for the hand-breaded box. 11px with 0.22em inside dark callouts.

styles.name: footer
styles.usage: Page footer: address left, phone right, in ink-muted above a 1.5px ink rule.

styles.name: fine-print
styles.sample: Consuming raw or undercooked meats … may increase your risk of foodborne illness.
styles.usage: Allergy note and consumer advisory, in ink-soft, lead-in words 600 in ink. 9pt: never smaller.

tokens.name: safe-zone
tokens.usage: The printer's dead zone: the outer 1/4in on every edge. Nothing but the page ground may sit inside it.

tokens.name: band-inset-top
tokens.usage: Distance from the top edge of the paper to the top of the decorative band.

tokens.name: band-inset-x
tokens.usage: Distance from each side edge to the band, so the band is 756px wide.

tokens.name: page-margin-x
tokens.usage: Left and right margin of all text on inside pages (0.58in).

tokens.name: page-margin-bottom
tokens.usage: Space below the footer text.

tokens.name: column-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between the two menu columns.

tokens.name: section-gap
tokens.usage: Space between the page header and the columns, and between major blocks.

tokens.name: item-gap
tokens.usage: Vertical gap between items, headings and notes in a column.

tokens.name: grid-row-gap
tokens.usage: Row gap in two-up item grids (appetizers).

tokens.name: list-gap
tokens.usage: Gap between lines of a compact list (sides).

tokens.name: leader-gap
tokens.usage: Gap on either side of the dotted leader between an item name and its price.

tokens.name: callout-pad-y
tokens.usage: Top and bottom padding inside a feature callout.

tokens.name: callout-pad-x
tokens.usage: Side padding inside a feature callout.

tokens.name: radius-frame
tokens.usage: Outer copper frame of the regular cover.

tokens.name: radius-box
tokens.usage: Outlined boxes and tinted groups: Sampler, Dressings, Hand-Breaded to Order.

tokens.name: radius-feature
tokens.usage: Solid feature callouts: Black Squirrel, Prime Rib, We Cater.

tokens.name: radius-chip
tokens.usage: Add-on chips (pill).

page.note: Print geometry at 96 px per inch, the unit every design file uses.

tokens.name: page-width
tokens.usage: US Letter width, 8.5in.

tokens.name: page-height
tokens.usage: US Letter height, 11in. Every page is one fixed sheet; content may never need more.

tokens.name: band-width
tokens.usage: Decorative band width (816 minus two band-inset-x).

tokens.name: band-height-checker
tokens.usage: Checkerboard band height: 8px squares in two rows.

tokens.name: band-height-seasonal
tokens.usage: Maximum height of a seasonal band (30px for most, 34px for the garland).
